# Vonssy Portfolio

> Vonssy (Reyvaldi Zakaria) is a Web3 builder and automation engineer based in Indonesia (UTC+7) who builds bots, wallet automation, and backend systems that interact with real APIs, blockchains, and data — tagline "Software that does things." Available for collaborations via Telegram and email.

## About
- [About — Vonssy background](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): From C/C++, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, Python, AI/ML and mobile fundamentals into software that runs against real wallets, blockchains, APIs, accounts, proxies, and data.
- [Philosophy — How Vonssy builds](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): Build for reality, automate the boring parts, prioritize reliability (retries, rate limits, proxies, concurrency), keep it practical.
- [Manifesto & approach](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/): Software should meet real network conditions — not just happy paths.

## Projects — Selected work (15 repositories across two GitHub accounts)
- [Cloud Storage App](https://github.com/REY-STTP/Cloud-Storage-App): Production-ready personal cloud storage with private Cloudflare R2 buckets, presigned downloads (60-min expiry), JWT httpOnly auth, Supabase PostgreSQL, batch zip streaming. Live at https://cloud-storage-app-brown.vercel.app
- [Vonssy Terminal](https://github.com/REY-STTP/Vonssy-Terminal): Read-only EVM multichain wallet analytics across 10 chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, BNB Chain, Avalanche, zkSync Era, Linea, Scroll) using Viem — no wallet connection required. Live at https://vonssy-terminal.vercel.app
- [Kusoparse](https://github.com/REY-STTP/Kusoparse): Parser that extracts Kusonime metadata, resolves shortlinks, returns direct download links with strict URL validation. Live at https://kusoparse.vercel.app
- [Guess Your Face](https://github.com/REY-STTP/Guess-Your-Face): Real-time AI facial detection, comparison and attribute analysis via Face++ — zero data retention, in-memory processing, Next.js 16 rebuild with bilingual ID/EN. Live at https://guess-your-expression.vercel.app
- [Vonssy-AI](https://github.com/REY-STTP/Vonssy-AI): Multi-provider AI chatbot with streamed SSE responses, persistent sessions, OAuth, HMAC identity hashing, three-layer quotas, Drizzle + PostgreSQL. Live at https://vonssy-ai.vercel.app
- [AIS Frozen Food](https://github.com/REY-STTP/AIS-Frozen-Food): High-performance landing page + interactive catalog for a frozen-food UMKM in Pati & Kudus with automated WhatsApp ordering. Live at https://ais-frozen-food.vercel.app
- [Desa Sukobubuk](https://github.com/REY-STTP/desa-sukobubuk): Official village website — profile, news, UMKM directory with products, gallery, contact pipeline backed by Prisma + PostgreSQL. Live at https://desa-sukobubuk.vercel.app
- [E-Voting](https://github.com/REY-STTP/E-Voting): Web3 e-voting dApp — connect EVM wallet, cast votes on-chain via ethers v6, live results, admin-guarded sessions. Live at https://e-voting-ebon-tau.vercel.app
- [PharosTestnet-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/PharosTestnet-BOT): Multi-account Web3 automation for Pharos Atlantic Testnet — check-ins, faucet claims, transfers, proxy-aware execution. 127 stars. Python, web3.py, EVM.
- [Dawn-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/Dawn-BOT): Dawn Validator manager — bearer-token extraction, account handling, proxy rotation, keep-alive pings, multithreading. 110 stars. Python, Multithreading, Proxies.
- [HeliosTestnet-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/HeliosTestnet-BOT): Helios testnet automation — faucet claims, bridging, validator delegation, governance, contract deployment, optional 2Captcha. 50 stars. Python, web3.py, Testnet.
- [Interlink-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/Interlink-BOT): Automated $ITLG token mining across private/group pools with metric synchronization, proxy rotation, APP_VERSION targeting. 33 stars. Python, Proxies, Mining.
- [X1-Ecochain-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/X1-Ecochain-BOT): X1 EcoChain airdrop farming — daily check-ins, quests, XIT faucet claims, transfers, swaps, liquidity, token deployment. 16 stars. Python, web3.py, EVM.
- [Deltahash-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/Deltahash-BOT): Automated $DTH mining + social-task completion using cookie-based sessions with proxy rotation. 14 stars. Python, Cookie Sessions, Proxies.
- [Konnex-BOT](https://github.com/vonssy/Konnex-BOT): Konnex Reward Hub points-farming with daily check-ins, testnet interactions, dual-wallet (EVM + mnemonic) configuration. 12 stars. Python, EVM, Proxies.
- [More on GitHub](https://github.com/vonssy): Full list of automation bots and tools at https://github.com/vonssy
- [More on GitHub (earlier work)](https://github.com/REY-STTP): Web applications and experiments at https://github.com/REY-STTP

## Stack — Working stack by function
- [Languages](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#stack): Python · JavaScript · TypeScript · PHP · C · C++ · SQL · Dart
- [Web](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#stack): Next.js · React · Node.js · Express · Tailwind CSS
- [Automation](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#stack): Multi-account flows · browser automation · scraping · APIs · concurrency · proxy systems
- [Web3](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#stack): EVM wallets · web3.py · RPC/API interaction · staking · swaps · bridges · testnets

## Philosophy — Principles
- [Build for reality](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): Software should meet real APIs, networks, wallets, services, and failure conditions.
- [Automate the boring parts](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): Repeated workflows become useful when they run predictably without supervision.
- [Reliability matters](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): Retries, rate limits, proxies, state, concurrency, and recovery deserve deliberate handling.
- [Keep it practical](https://www.vonssy-portfolio.web.id/#about): Prefer understandable systems over abstractions that make the work harder to operate.
